en: Nope! There's only rubbish in here.

Hey! There's a switch under the rubbish! {player} pressed it.
The first electric lock opened!

Nope! There's only rubbish in here.
Hey! The electric locks were reset!

There's another switch under the rubbish! {player} pressed it.
The second electric lock opened, and the gates are down!
Lt. Surge
Hey, you! You came all the way from Johto? Ha! You've got guts, I'll give you that.
Electricity saved my hide more times than I can count. Now let's see you take a jolt of it!
Whoa! That's some real power you've got! All right, you've earned it. Take the Thunder Badge!
{player} received the Thunder Badge from Lt. Surge!
And take this too. It's a move that charges you up while it hits!
TM57 is Charge Beam. Every hit has a good chance to raise your Pokémon's Special Attack.
Electricity is mighty, but it's nothing against Ground types. Keep that in mind, and you'll go far!
Gym Guide
Hey, champ! Welcome to Kanto! Lt. Surge has locked himself in behind electric gates.
The switches are hidden in the bins round the hall. Find the first, and the second is always right beside it!
His Pokémon are Electric types, so a Ground type is your best friend here.
What a shocking battle! You really lit Lt. Surge up.

Vermilion City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Lt. Surge
A beam of electricity crackles across the way. It must be switched off somewhere in the Gym.
